about: Dana's add-on catalog (https://github.com/ronganam/dana, docs/addons.md, "The catalog"). Each source.ref is a full commit hash: an entry is exactly one version of its add-on; touches (optional) is what that version declares it may touch, shown before installing. Servers read this file from GitHub (DANA_CATALOG_URL); entries that are not valid are skipped, with the reason in their log. Adding or updating an entry: README.md.
